entries.description: Avuz child skin extending Elastic. Overrides primary color (#2bb5e3 cyan), accent (#d2e314 lime), background (#f2f6fb). Login page with rounded form and lime submit button.
entries.notes: CSS targets Elastic DOM classes. If Roundcube changes Elastic class names in a future version, selectors may silently break. Review skins/elastic/ diff on upgrade.

entries.description: SSO plugin that reads ?nc_token= from the Nextcloud roundcube app, validates HMAC-SHA256 signature, decrypts the password with AES-256-CBC, and auto-authenticates the user. Falls back to login form if token is absent or invalid.
entries.notes: Requires ROUNDCUBE_SSO_SECRET and ROUNDCUBE_CREDENTIAL_KEY env vars on both Roundcube and Nextcloud containers. Token TTL is 60 seconds.

entries.description: Roundcube config: Zoho IMAP (imap.zoho.com:993 SSL) and SMTP (smtp.zoho.com:587 TLS), Redis/DB cache with messages_cache enabled, pt_BR locale, 'Conecta Mail' product name.
entries.notes: All secrets come from env vars. ROUNDCUBE_DES_KEY must never change after first deploy or stored passwords become unreadable.

entries.description: Two-stage Docker build (base + app). PHP 8.2 FPM + Nginx + Supervisor. Entrypoint initializes DB schema on first boot. Multi-platform build scripts (arm64 local, amd64 staging/prod).
entries.notes: Registry: 10.50.100.103:8080/admin/avuz-roundcube. Base image only needs rebuild when PHP version or extensions change.
